job.title: Software Engineer II - Flows Experience
job.workplace: On-site in Boston, 5 days a week
job.pay_full: $116,000 – $174,000 a year base pay range across US locations

details.about: Flows is how tens of thousands of brands automate their marketing on Klaviyo, from welcome series and abandoned-cart reminders to multi-channel journeys reaching 100M+ consumers. The Flows Experience team builds everything a marketer touches in a flow — the canvas, triggers, filters and actions, the analytics, and the APIs developers and AI tools use to build flows. Klaviyo wants a full-stack engineer to own features end to end, from the React canvas down to the Python services and APIs.
duties: Own major parts of the Flows product (builder, analytics, version history, management surfaces) from design through launch and operation
Design and evolve the public and internal Flows APIs
Keep the product fast and reliable for very large flows and accounts
Build guardrails that catch mistakes before they cost a brand revenue: validation, safe defaults, clear feedback and easy recovery
Partner with the Flows Platform team on the contract between the product and the engine
Raise the team's bar through design reviews, mentorship and operational excellence
needs: You've built and shipped products customers rely on, and care about user experience as much as code
Strong across the stack, with deep knowledge of at least one area (complex front-end apps, API design or backend performance)
Enjoy hard problems where UX meets systems
Ship early and often, iterating with data and customer feedback
Thrive on a small, autonomous team
Curiosity about how AI changes what is built and how it is built
details.benefits: Base pay range for US locations $116,000 – $174,000 a year; the offer depends on skills, experience, education or training, and work location. Total compensation may include the annual cash bonus plan, equity, sign-on payments and a comprehensive range of health, welfare and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility.
notes: On-site in Boston, MA, 5 days a week
Technologies include React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Django, Celery, MySQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, AWS and Terraform
Klaviyo will never ask for payment or bank details during the application process
